geopolitics.summary: Today's lens covers developments in geopolitics, humanitarian crises, and regional conflicts, highlighting the complex interplay of international relations and global challenges.

stories.title: US lawmakers ask Trump administration to stop deportation of Afghans
stories.body: US lawmakers have asked the Trump administration to halt the deportation of Afghan refugees, citing humanitarian concerns and the potential for further instability in the region. The request comes as the US continues to support the Afghan government and address the humanitarian crisis in Afghanistan.
stories.whyItMatters: The decision reflects the ongoing tension between national security policies and humanitarian obligations, highlighting the complexities of international refugee policies.

stories.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre
stories.body: A Russian bombing targeted an aid centre in Kyiv, killing 26 people. The attack occurred amid heightened tensions in the region, with both sides engaging in military activities and diplomatic talks. The incident underscores the ongoing conflict and its impact on civilian populations.
stories.whyItMatters: The attack highlights the human cost of conflict and the challenges of maintaining humanitarian access in war-torn areas.

stories.title: Ebola outbreak kills more than 5,300 people in DR Congo
stories.body: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed the lives of over 5,300 people, highlighting the ongoing public health crisis and the challenges of controlling the virus in affected regions. The outbreak has led to increased international attention and efforts to contain the spread of the disease.
stories.whyItMatters: The outbreak underscores the importance of global health cooperation and the need for rapid response to prevent further casualties and spread of the disease.

science.summary: Today's lens covers advancements in science, environmental concerns, and global research developments.

stories.title: New method to save hundreds from dumpster diving
stories.body: A BBC Science report highlights a novel approach to combat dumpster diving, where individuals are trained to identify and assist those in need. The initiative aims to reduce the risk of exposure to diseases and environmental hazards, emphasizing community support and public health.
stories.whyItMatters: This initiative underscores the importance of community-based solutions in addressing public health challenges.

stories.title: Chinese PhD students can graduate without a thesis
stories.body: Nature reports that Chinese PhD students in clinical medicine can now graduate without submitting a thesis, reflecting a shift in academic standards and the growing emphasis on practical training over traditional research requirements.
stories.whyItMatters: This development may influence future academic pathways and research practices in medical education.

stories.title: IceCube detects ghost particles with unprecedented energy
stories.body: ScienceDaily reports that the IceCube detector has detected particles with 10 billion times the energy of solar neutrinos, offering new insights into fundamental physics and potential explanations for cosmic phenomena.
stories.whyItMatters: This discovery could lead to breakthroughs in understanding the universe's fundamental forces and energy sources.

economy.summary: Today's lens covers key economic developments, including US legislative actions, UK-EU trade agreements, cyber-attacks, oil prices, and US-China trade dynamics.

stories.title: US lawmakers ask Trump administration to stop deportation of Afghans
stories.body: US lawmakers have asked the Trump administration to halt the deportation of Afghan refugees, citing humanitarian concerns. The request comes as the US faces increasing pressure to address the humanitarian crisis in Afghanistan. The move reflects a broader trend of legislative action on immigration and refugee policies.
stories.whyItMatters: The decision highlights the growing political and humanitarian tensions around refugee policies and the impact of global conflicts on international migration.

stories.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
stories.body: The UK and EU have reached an agreement to remove trade barriers for food exports, aiming to boost economic ties and support the UK's agricultural sector. The deal is seen as a step toward resolving long-standing trade disputes and fostering economic cooperation between the two regions.
stories.whyItMatters: The agreement could reshape trade relations and economic cooperation between the UK and EU, impacting food exports and trade policies in the region.

stories.title: Oil price falls amid hope of a breakthrough to end Iran war
stories.body: Oil prices have fallen due to hopes of a breakthrough in the Iran war, as global markets anticipate a potential end to the conflict. The drop in prices could influence energy policies and economic strategies in the US and other major economies.
stories.whyItMatters: The fluctuation in oil prices could impact global energy markets and economic planning, especially in the context of geopolitical tensions and trade policies.
